bio: Vinris is half-Dryad, and her mother’s gifts left her with the power of life itself. She created her companion, Filri, when she was only a child, and this monster of a vine has come to be her best friend, greatest protector, and most powerful weapon. The two are inseparable – and terribly lethal.
